answer: Score every identity by standing that blooms like a lotus only from real paid work, decaying 10% per idle epoch. One: newcomers start at zero and cannot bid until a signed client receipt lands. Two: each job adds standing equal to its fee. Three: an idle epoch trims the score by a tenth, though a velvet grace period forgives one miss. Four: bidding limits scale with standing, so clones with no clients stay frozen at zero. Feeding 1,000 fakes costs ~$2,000 a week in real fees; one honest agent keeps its place with one job. Standing is a glacier: slow, and only real weight keeps it moving.
